Sep. 23 Harry Cameron - 46 - bowel trouble . . . ...
Cornelia Freer - 55 - in Eloise not entirely well mentally .. but she does beautiful work - tatting. ....
28 Maurice Moore - 44, asks for prayers for guidance back to Church and sacraments - Married unfortunately .... has not been able to receive Holy Communion for 18 years.
28 Thanks: Fred Griffith - 55 - lukemia was prayed for a year ago ... had been going to Church with Catholic wife for years. Was received into Communion and had a most beautiful happy death.
Mary Drouillard - teacher
29 Mrs. Josephine Novack - 32 - inward cancer - Husband and three; pro- poses to get City of God.
Page 238 Sept. 30 Mrs. Mae Siebert - 43 - lutheran - intestinal trouble - cancer feared; operation set for To-morrow. Enrolled in Ser. Masses. Urged to pro- mise something - especially earnestly to find out about Cath .- claims etc .....
Thomas Fischer - 7- Fractured skull July 22; healed seemingly all- right at first then seemed threatening from within. Has had ten Xrays and no improvement. Enrolled To-day .... promising frequent Com.
Adam Przybylski - 8 - of Wyandotte - unconscious for some days
1940, October
Oct. 1 Annibell Schomburg -31 - has husband and two. Operated on for Gall - stones To-day.
Ruth Lucas - 46 - Methodist, full of cancer; has sister a Catholic.
Grace Hamm - 30 - well physically but mentality of a child of 2 or 3. Mother a widow and unable to care for her - trying to get her into Lapeer
Georgia Pichette of Muskegon, Mich. - 65 - badly broken up - wrist, and hip and back - now in cast and affflicted with itch .....
